title: Sable and the Asset
author: Hazel Vasquez
blurb: Edmund Yarrow, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
